subject: NeoArk capacity mapping & contingency hold for late-stage commitment
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Ella Shaw <ella.shaw@neoark.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Jul 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: NeoArk capacity mapping & contingency hold for late-stage commitment

Hi Ella —

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday. As NeoArk moves toward an internal signoff window (you mentioned EOW for a term-sheet), we want to propose a short contingency/soft-hold so we can reserve a modest slice of Dedicated capacity while your legal/procurement finishes up.

Attached is a provisional sizing worksheet (provisional-sizing.xlsx) with two scenarios: a conservative ramp (8x A100 equivalent GPUs across 2 regions) and an accelerated ramp (24x A100 equivalent) tied to a 12-week onboarding plan. Can you confirm which scenario best matches the committed traffic you expect in Q4? Also send the final model/profile (batch sizes, peak concurrent requests, seq length distribution) if you have it — that will help ops pick the right instance mix.

Operationally we typically hold a soft allocation for 14 days with the option to extend once a PO/MOU is in place; if you need a longer runway we can discuss an incremental deposit to secure the nodes for 30–60 days.

Next steps:
- Ella: confirm scenario (conservative / accelerated) and upload workload summary
- NeoArk salesops: if you want a DocuSign MOU we can route a one-page hold MOU (target sign in 48h)
- Internal: Markus / Monica — can you run an availability check on the West US & East US pools and flag any overlapping late-stage commitments?

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a short internal ops packet once I have the workload doc.

Best,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0193

Attachment: provisional-sizing.xlsx

From: Ella Shaw <ella.shaw@neoark.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: salesops@neoark.ai
Date: Mon, 15 Jul 2029 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: NeoArk capacity mapping & contingency hold for late-stage commitment

Hi Karthik —

Thanks — attaching the workload summary you asked for (neoark_workload_summary.pdf). Short answers below:
- We’re currently planning for the conservative scenario at initial sign (targeting a 12-week onboarding). If we can hit the revenue milestone in Q1 we will trigger the accelerated ramp (likely within 3 months).
- Peak concurrency: ~250 concurrent sessions, median seq len 512, 99th pct > 1024 for a subset of requests.
- Preferred regions: primary US-West, secondary US-East.

For the soft-hold length — 14 days is fine if we can get a simple one-page MOU in DocuSign to lock the slot. NeoArk is okay with a nominal good-faith deposit if that’s required for 30-day protection; please send terms so we can review with procurement.

We’d like the hold to cover at least a 8x A100-equivalent baseline with the option to scale to 24x.

Thanks,
Ella
Ella Shaw | Head of Infrastructure | NeoArk
ella.shaw@neoark.ai | +1 (206) 555-0137

Attachment: neoark_workload_summary.pdf

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Jul 2029 14:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: NeoArk capacity mapping & contingency hold for late-stage commitment

Karthik / Monica —

Quick ops read based on the attached workload:
- The West-US dedicated pool has a roughly 12–16 GPU-equivalent short window over the next 21 days before a scheduled shard turn-up for another committed enterprise customer (INF-1089). That means we can comfortably cover the 8x baseline in US-West for the 14-day soft-hold, but sustaining 24x in the same region would conflict with the existing ramp unless NeoArk commits to either (a) secondary region in US-East or (b) a deposit to bump their priority.
- Recommended instance mix: 6x A100-80GB (baseline) + 2x T4/technical for batch preprocessing nodes, or optionally 8x H100 if NeoArk opts for denser single-node throughput. We should avoid fractional oversubscription during peak RLHF runs (their 99th pct >1024 note).
- Ops ticket: creating INF-1124 (soft-hold request, NeoArk NX-2029-1134). Will include proposed node mapping and tentative reservation window (2029-07-16 -> 2029-07-30).

Flags / decisions needed:
- Do we allow a 30-day soft extension with deposit? If yes we need to surface finance terms.
- Do we push the 24x accelerated ramp into US-East to avoid impacting INF-1089?

-Markus
Markus Klein | Head of Capacity Planning | Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0246

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Ella Shaw <ella.shaw@neoark.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Jul 2029 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: NeoArk capacity mapping & contingency hold for late-stage commitment

Ella —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the workload doc. Markus ran an availability sweep and opened INF-1124 to formalize the soft-hold for the conservative scenario (8x A100-eq). Summary of what we propose to put into the one-page MOU:
- Reserved capacity: 8x A100-equivalent in US-West (soft-hold 2029-07-16 -> 2029-07-30)
- Option to scale to 24x mapped to US-East within 30 days on receipt of deposit or PO
- Soft-hold fee / deposit: nominal (we propose $10k refundable against first invoice) if NeoArk wants a 30-day exclusive runway
- Onboarding SLA: dedicated CSM + priority scheduling for kernel tuning during first 4 weeks

I’m attaching a DocuSign link for a one-page MOU (https://www.docusign.com/neoark-mou/NX-2029-1134). If you can sign, I’ll instruct Markus to lock the nodes and Monica to open the billing deposit flow.

If procurement needs different wording on the deposit, loop in salesops and we’ll get legal to trim it.

Thanks — aiming to close the hold by EOD tomorrow so we don’t lose the West-US window.

Best,
Karthik

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Jul 2029 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: NeoArk capacity mapping & contingency hold for late-stage commitment

Markus / Karthik —

Confirming: INF-1124 created and hold applied to West-US pool for 8x A100-equivalent (2029-07-16 through 2029-07-30). Billing flow ticket INF-BILL-678 opened to accept the $10k deposit if NeoArk signs DocuSign. Hold ticket ID and summary attached (hold_ticket_1124.pdf).

Notes for handoff:
- If DocuSign completes before COB 2029-07-16, ops will notate the hold as "exclusive" and allocate network VLANs for NeoArk.
- If DocuSign is delayed past 2029-07-20, we will convert the hold to a "best-effort" reservation unless deposit clears.

I’ll keep this thread updated with status; tagging Laura to prep a short runbook for onboarding once the MOU is signed.

Thanks,
Monica
